Prerequisite(s): Dexterity 13, Airship Dodge feat

Benefit: When piloting an airship, you apply a +4 dodge bonus to your airship's AC against attacks of opportunity caused when you out of or within an airship's threatened area. Any condition that makes your lose your Dexterity bonus to AC also makes you lose your dodge bonuses. Dodge bonuses (such as this one and the dodge bonus granted by the Airship Dodge feat) stack with each other, unlike most types of bonuses.
